description:
Get details for a Sentry release.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Inspect an exact release version
- Scope a release lookup to a specific project
- See deploys and environments for a release
- See recent commits attached to a release
- Gather release health metadata when a project is known

To find issues introduced in a release, call search_issues with query `release:<version>`.

<examples>
get_release_details(organizationSlug='my-organization', releaseVersion='1.2.3')
get_release_details(organizationSlug='my-organization', releaseVersion='1.2.3', projectSlugOrId='backend')
get_release_details(organizationSlug='my-organization', releaseVersion='1.2.3', includeHealth=true, projectSlugOrId='backend')
</examples>

includeCommits.description: Include recent commits attached to this release.

includeDeploys.description: Include recent deploys for this release.

includeHealth.description: Include project-specific release health metadata. Requires projectSlugOrId unless the session is already project-constrained.

limit.description: Maximum number of deploys and commits to return, up to 50.

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

anyOf.description: Optional project slug or numeric ID. Use this to scope release details, deploys, and commits to one project; required for health metadata unless the session is already project-constrained.

The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'. For self-hosted Sentry installations, this parameter is usually not needed and should be omitted. You can find the correct regionUrl from the organization details using the `find_organizations()` tool.

name: get_release_details

commits.description: Recent commits. Null when includeCommits is false.

deploys.description: Recent deploys. Null when includeDeploys is false.

health.description: Release health metadata. Null unless includeHealth is true.

title: Get Release Details
